graphs: Seven elevation contours at 100 m intervals

formulas.ascii: Each crossed edge uses u=clamp((level-first)/(second-first),0,1); if differences overflow, divide all heights by max(1,abs(level),abs(first),abs(second)); zero scaled denominator gives u=0.5. Positions are local pixel centers (+0.5 for area pixels). Equal heights count as high; flat or invalid-corner cells emit nothing; saddle pairing uses the asymptotic determinant with high-diagonal tie; counts clamp to capacity and overflow reports truncation.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
